description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'ExternalOAuthProviderConnector' that implements OAuth 2.0 provider interactions, such as obtaining authorization URLs, access tokens, and refresh tokens. It is part of a suite CRM system and interacts with external OAuth providers through a provider interface and configuration stored in a database entity. It includes methods for generating provider instances, handling OAuth flow steps, and mapping tokens.

classes.name: ExternalOAuthProviderConnector
classes.description: An abstract class providing OAuth 2.0 provider interaction methods, configuration handling, and token mapping.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider connector with a provider ID.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Creates and returns an OAuth provider instance using configuration and client credentials.

methods.name: getAuthorizeURL
methods.description: Generates an authorization URL for OAuth flow.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves an access token using the provided authorization code.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.description: Refreshes an expired access token using a refresh token.

methods.name: getProviderConfig
methods.description: Fetches configuration array for the OAuth provider from database.

methods.name: getClientID
methods.description: Determines the client ID to use based on session and configuration.

methods.name: getClientSecret
methods.description: Determines the client secret to use based on session and configuration.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI from the provider configuration.

methods.name: getExtraProviderParams
methods.description: Returns any additional parameters for provider configuration.

methods.name: getAuthorizeURLOptions
methods.description: Returns options for generating the authorization URL.

methods.name: getAccessTokenRequestOptions
methods.description: Returns options for access token request.

methods.name: getAccessTokenRequestGrant
methods.description: Returns the grant type for token requests.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenRequestOptions
methods.description: Returns options for refresh token request.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenRequestGrant
methods.description: Returns the grant type for refresh token requests.

methods.name: getArrayValue
methods.description: Fetches a nested array value given a dot-separated path.

methods.name: mapTokenDynamically
methods.description: Maps token data dynamically based on token mapping configuration.
